claims.quote: The access panel at the back was a hair ajar; the brass inside looked thumbed, varnish rubbed away where skin or a tool had rested. Fine, fresh scores ringed the latch—hairline marks that flashed when the light caught them, as if a slender implement had been used to lever it.
claims.value: fresh tool marks and hairline scores around latch

claims.quote: At the base the black thread hung where I'd seen it: waxed, stiff, snagged on a screw. I followed its line: it looped and ran up toward the movement and vanished behind the plates.
claims.value: thread looped and ran up toward movement, vanishing behind plates

claims.quote: "I was in three days ago to wind it and I stripped the weight-gear to clean the pivots—it's delicate work, Ellis."
claims.value: admitted servicing clock three days ago to wind and strip weight-gear to clean pivots

claims.quote: "I was out of the shop just before eleven. Ask anyone."

claims.quote: The ragged edge lay on top of the knuckles; the torn fibres splayed against the skin rather than pressed into it. The blotter beneath showed a neat, round stain—the dark halo of a single shot. The scrap sat on that halo without a smear. If he'd clutched the paper in his last moments the fibres would have been pressed, ink and blood rubbed into the edge. This looked arranged.
claims.value: inference: torn note placed after death (fibres lying on top, no blood transfer)

claims.quote: "We lifted a partial print from the flap's crease," he said. "Preliminary lift consistent with Iris Harben."
claims.value: partial latent print lifted from diagonal crease on flap; preliminary lift consistent with Iris Harben
